verdict.rationale: Gazebo ships built-in sensor models that generate data, optionally with noise, from laser range finders, 2D/3D cameras, IMU and GPS, so all four sensor types are covered in simulation. That data flows over Gazebo Transport pub/sub, and ros_gz installs alongside ROS. However, these are simulated sensors rather than drivers for physical hardware, and the evidence never documents the standard message types or a ROS message bridge for them. Missing for 10: drivers for physical cameras/lidars/IMUs/GPS, documented standard message definitions or ROS message mapping for each sensor, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can integrate cameras, lidars, IMUs, and GPS with ready-made drivers and standard message types

citations.quote: Generate sensor data, optionally with noise, from laser range finders, 2D/3D cameras, Kinect style sensors, contact sensors, force-torque, IMU, GPS, and more
Asynchronous message publication and subscription is provided along with service calls and discovery.
sudo apt-get install ros-${ROS_DISTRO}-ros-gz  This command will install the Gazebo libraries recommended for your ROS installation.
